promises.title: The God of hope fills you
promises.originalAudience: The believers in Rome, in benediction
promises.receptionGuidance: Hope here is not optimism; it is the Spirit's own work in a believer.

promises.title: A refuge that is very present
promises.receptionGuidance: The psalm's 'our' includes every believer who runs to Him — including you.

promises.title: Angels charged over you
promises.originalAudience: The one who makes the LORD his refuge (v.9)
conditions: Because thou hast made the LORD… thy habitation (Psalm 91:9).
promises.receptionGuidance: Spoken to the one who makes the LORD their habitation (91:9). Receive it as God's care for those who shelter in Him.

changes: Reception guidance rewritten to keep the original audience and avoid an individual guarantee.

promises.title: Every need supplied
conditions: Spoken to the Philippians in thanks for their sacrificial gift (Philippians 4:14-18).
promises.contextNote: Spoken to a church that had sacrificially given (4:14-18); it comforts givers, and is not a blanket wealth guarantee.
promises.receptionGuidance: Spoken to the Philippians who had given sacrificially (4:14-18). It comforts generous trust; it is not a formula for wealth.

changes: Reception guidance rewritten to keep the original audience and avoid an individual guarantee.

promises.title: All grace abounding
promises.originalAudience: The generous church at Corinth (giving for Judea)
conditions: Spoken to the Corinthians about cheerful, generous giving (2 Corinthians 9:6-7).
promises.receptionGuidance: Grace for sufficiency in everything, for every good work.

promises.title: Grace sufficient in weakness
promises.receptionGuidance: The Lord's answer to Paul's thorn stands for every believer who brings theirs.

promises.title: The LORD fights for you
promises.originalAudience: Israel trapped at the Red Sea
promises.receptionGuidance: Moses' word to Israel trapped at the Red Sea. It reveals the God who fights for His people; it does not promise a particular outcome in every conflict.

changes: Reception guidance rewritten to keep the original audience and avoid an individual guarantee.

promises.title: Wisdom given liberally
conditions: Let him ask of God… But let him ask in faith, nothing wavering (James 1:6).
promises.receptionGuidance: An open invitation — ask, without fear of reproach.

promises.title: Kept in perfect peace
promises.originalAudience: Judah, in the song of the strong city
conditions: Whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
promises.receptionGuidance: The condition is a stayed mind; the keeping is His.

promises.title: His peace, not the world's
promises.originalAudience: The eleven, on the night He was betrayed
promises.receptionGuidance: Given by Jesus to troubled men the night before the cross.

promises.title: He finishes what He begins
promises.receptionGuidance: The good work in you is a work God started — and God completes.

promises.title: Your expectation holds
conditions: Be thou in the fear of the LORD all the day long (Proverbs 23:17).
promises.receptionGuidance: Wisdom's word to the disciple: the end is sure, the expectation will stand.

promises.title: Children taught of the LORD
promises.receptionGuidance: Spoken to Zion after exile. It reveals God's intention for the children of His people; it is not a guarantee about any particular child.

changes: Reception guidance rewritten to keep the original audience and avoid an individual guarantee.

promises.title: I will instruct thee
conditions: Spoken to the forgiven worshipper who confessed sin (Psalm 32:5-6).
promises.receptionGuidance: God's own word to the forgiven — instruction with a watchful eye.

promises.title: This is the way
promises.receptionGuidance: A word behind you when paths fork.

promises.title: Possible to him that believeth
promises.originalAudience: The father of the afflicted boy
promises.receptionGuidance: Jesus honours even trembling faith, honestly brought.

promises.title: Be strong and of a good courage
promises.originalAudience: Israel, as leadership passes to Joshua
promises.receptionGuidance: Courage grounded in companionship: He will not fail or forsake.

promises.title: Health restored, wounds healed
promises.receptionGuidance: Spoken to outcast Zion; reveals the God who restores.

promises.title: He healeth the broken in heart
promises.receptionGuidance: The God of galaxies binds up wounds — both are true of Him.

promises.title: My presence shall go with thee
promises.receptionGuidance: God's personal word to Moses — presence as provision for the road.

promises.title: With you always
promises.originalAudience: The eleven disciples, commissioned on the mountain
promises.receptionGuidance: The last word of the Gospel of Matthew is presence, to the end.

promises.title: Whosoever believeth
promises.receptionGuidance: The offer of the gospel, spoken to one seeking man at night.

promises.title: The gift of God
promises.receptionGuidance: Wages versus gift: eternal life is given, never earned.
